description: [No sign-in required] Read the signed public status behind a disclosed ProofTask /v/result_… link. Pass the final result_ segment as resultId. Only status is public. A 404 leaves the state unknown. Verify the signature with independently confirmed keys from getTrustBundle. Refresh the statement after body.freshUntil.

resultId.description: Copy the result_ identifier from the disclosed status link: the prefix followed by 64 lowercase hex digits. A Conformity Record URN identifies a different artifact.

name: getResultStatus

body.description: Status data covered by the signature.

coreVersionDigest.description: Digest of the result core for comparison with an exported record.

freshUntil.description: UTC cutoff after which this observation cannot establish current status.

headEventHash.description: Hash of the latest event covered by this observation.

keyId.description: Look up this key ID in getTrustBundle.

nextUpdate.description: UTC timestamp to request a fresh observation.

resultId.description: Result named by the disclosed link.

state.description: Recorded state of the result at statusAsOf.

statusAsOf.description: UTC timestamp when the state was observed.

signature.description: Signature over the status body, to verify with an independently confirmed issuer key.

title: Check a public result link
